boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Ten named Saint Vincent spaces for studying, creating, gathering, reflection, and outdoor learning.

cards.title: Dale P. Latimer Library
cards.subtitle: Research, quiet work, and group study
cards.notes: Bring a laptop for Wi-Fi, choose a quiet area or reserve an appropriate group-study room, then use the catalog or ask at circulation for research help.
cards.short_summary: A campus library with places for both focused work and collaboration.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Vincent identifies the Latimer Library as a hub for academic work and collaboration, with quiet areas, group study rooms, research resources, and Wi-Fi.
cards.access_notes: Building and service hours vary during the year; check the library schedule before visiting.

cards.title: Robert S. Carey Student Center
cards.subtitle: A multi-use campus gathering point
cards.notes: Use the building as a practical meet-up point before a campus program, then confirm which areas and activities are open that day through Student Life or event listings.
cards.short_summary: The student center combines student services, recreation, arts, and gathering spaces.
cards.evidence_claim: The College catalog says the Carey Student Center contains the student union, game room, fitness center, Performing Arts Center, pool, Chapel, bookstore, The Shack, and other campus spaces.
cards.access_notes: Individual facilities and programs may have separate access requirements or schedules.

cards.title: Citrone Family Commuter Center
cards.subtitle: Placid Hall’s dedicated commuter lounge
cards.notes: Commuter students can use downtime between classes at the tables, kitchenette, pool table, TV, and wireless internet; check in with commuter affairs for current access details.
cards.short_summary: A purpose-built lounge for Saint Vincent’s commuter students.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Vincent describes the Citrone Family Commuter Center as a first-floor Placid Hall commuter lounge with a kitchenette, study tables, pool table, TV, and wireless internet.
cards.access_notes: This space is designated for commuter students.

cards.title: Saint Benedict Hall Pod Lounges
cards.subtitle: First-year community spaces
cards.notes: First-year residents can use their pod lounge for a game, program, Bible study, or informal time with neighbors while following residence-hall guest and quiet-hour rules.
cards.short_summary: Each first-year pod has a themed lounge designed for shared activity.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Vincent says Saint Benedict Hall has 21 first-year pods, each with its own themed lounge for bonding and activities; programs, games, and Bible studies occur in pod life.
cards.access_notes: Residential access is for authorized students and subject to housing policies.

cards.entity_name: Mary, Mother of Wisdom Student Chapel
cards.title: Mary, Mother of Wisdom Student Chapel
cards.subtitle: Campus Ministry worship and reflection
cards.notes: Check Campus Ministry’s current service schedule, then attend a listed Mass, prayer service, or worship program in the College’s student chapel.
cards.short_summary: A dedicated student chapel within the Carey Student Center.
cards.evidence_claim: Campus Ministry states that it holds weekly services in Mary, Mother of Wisdom Student Chapel and invites students to participate as lectors, cantors, ushers, and hospitality ministers.
cards.access_notes: Service times are published by Campus Ministry; participation should follow the current schedule.

cards.title: Saint Vincent Archabbey Basilica
cards.subtitle: Weekly Campus Ministry services
cards.notes: Look up the current Campus Ministry worship schedule and attend a listed service in the Basilica; students interested in ministry roles can contact Campus Ministry.
cards.short_summary: A major campus worship site shared with the student chapel’s weekly schedule.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Vincent Campus Ministry says it has weekly service times in the Archabbey Basilica and the Mary, Mother of Wisdom Student Chapel.
cards.access_notes: Use the current Campus Ministry schedule for service times and visitor guidance.

cards.title: Winnie Palmer Nature Reserve
cards.subtitle: Trails, wetlands, and outdoor learning
cards.notes: Take a daylight walk on the reserve’s trails or join a relevant class or program; stay on marked routes and respect the protected woodlands, wetlands, and meadows.
cards.short_summary: A 50-acre reserve near campus with trails and environmental-learning facilities.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Vincent says the reserve includes more than 50 acres of protected land, two miles of trails, an Environmental Learning Barn, and opportunities for student study, work, and exploration.
cards.access_notes: Use established trails and follow posted reserve guidance; some academic activities are course- or program-based.

cards.entity_name: Angelo Taiani Planetarium and Astronaut Exhibit
cards.title: Angelo Taiani Planetarium and Astronaut Exhibit
cards.subtitle: Dupré Science Pavilion
cards.notes: Watch for a scheduled planetarium program or class event, and pair the visit with a look at the astronaut exhibit in the Science Pavilion.
cards.short_summary: A named astronomy destination inside the Science Pavilion.
cards.evidence_claim: The Boyer School lists the Angelo Taiani Planetarium and Astronaut Exhibit among the facilities inside the Sis and Herman Dupré Science Pavilion.
cards.source_title: Dupré Science Pavilion Facilities | Saint Vincent College
cards.access_notes: Availability depends on academic programming and facility access; confirm before making a special trip.

cards.title: General Computing Lab
cards.subtitle: WG-02, Dupré Science Pavilion
cards.notes: Use an open-work period to complete coursework on a desktop computer or print materials, while yielding priority to scheduled classes and following lab rules.
cards.short_summary: A computer lab that the College explicitly identifies as student study space.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Vincent says the General Computing Lab in WG-02 has 24 desktop computers and two printers and is open to students for assignments and study space.
cards.source_title: Dupré Science Pavilion Facilities | Saint Vincent College
cards.access_notes: The lab is also used for classes; verify availability before relying on a workstation.

cards.title: Fred M. Rogers Center
cards.subtitle: Archives, gallery, and campus events
cards.notes: Check the Center’s or College’s public schedule for an exhibition, talk, or event, and plan your visit around the specific space or program that is open.
cards.short_summary: A campus center housing Fred Rogers archival material and a coverlet gallery.
cards.evidence_claim: The Saint Vincent College catalog says the Fred M. Rogers Center houses the Fred Rogers Archive and the Foster and Muriel McCarl Coverlet Gallery.
cards.access_notes: Gallery, archive, and event access can vary; consult the current College schedule before visiting.
